messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: shiny deployment arch.
parts:
Node.js effectively acts as a proxy. The "Shiny" work is all done by an R process running Shiny on the back-end. Each application gets its own R process running Shiny; in Pro an application can have multiple R processes backing it.

Jeff
